E3511

Generated source has two producers: `{chain}`.

What

Generated source has two producers: `{chain}`.

Why

Each generated module and its path have one producer, so what compiles never depends on which producer ran last.

Fix

Give each generated module its own name, and keep steps from writing a generated module's path.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3511: tests/ui/build_generated_cycle/stderr.

Error [jet.GenerationCycle]: Build plan is invalid: module `alpha` is generated twice
  --> tests/ui/build_generated_cycle/run.jet:7:7
    |
  7 |     b.generate("alpha") {
    |       ^^^^^^^^
